values.note: Six electric sites in the Minneiska campground stay open through the winter (200E, 203E, 205E, 206E, 208E, 212E); Cedar Hill closes for the winter. Showers, flush toilets and water run mid-April to mid-October.

note: Two drive-in campgrounds in the Whitewater River valley, from open and grassy to wooded: Cedar Hill west of Hwy 74 (mostly electric, plus non-electric and cart-in sites) and Minneiska east of it (all electric). --Claude
